_comment: Task 1 (Level 1) of docs/COWORK_BRIEF_model_bench.md -- a standing, committed evaluation set of real conversation ids for the model bench. Pinned inputs only: well-formedness and throughput, not correctness (that is Level 2, not yet built -- see README.md in this folder). Short and medium are ORDERED PREFIXES of this list, per the brief's working rules -- do not reorder without re-deriving the tiers below.

source.note: Conversation ids were selected from this migration snapshot, not a live store. Before a bench run, confirm each id still resolves in the live cli_transcripts_home / cowork_transcripts_home for the machine the run is on -- a store can rotate or prune between snapshot and run, and a missing id is a stop condition (silent substitution is not).

conversations.title: Generate markdown templates from docs
conversations.why: Smoke case: trivial CLI-store session (3 records, ~500 chars). Tests whether a candidate can round-trip the smallest possible real input at all before spending time on anything larger.

conversations.title: troubleshooting request - seem to be having trouble activate venv :S ...
conversations.why: Deliberately off-topic edge case: a short venv-troubleshooting exchange with no build-task shape and no decisions in it. Exercises what a candidate does when a conversation has nothing worth extracting -- the correct answer is close to zero claims, not a hallucinated one.

conversations.title: COWORK_BRIEF_repo_tier_producers.md
conversations.why: Ordinary small build-task conversation with a matching committed brief (docs/COWORK_BRIEF_repo_tier_producers.md) and report -- a ground-truth candidate for Level 2 once that's built, since the claims it should yield are checkable against docs/DECISIONS.md and the brief/report pair.

conversations.title: CRYSTAL SPIRE -- content thread: DENIZEN DIALOGUE AUDIT, ERAS 1-2 (read-only, analytical)
conversations.why: Breadth of project: L5GN-Crystal-Spire is a different repo/project entirely, with a different register (content/narrative audit, not engineering). The short tier should not be all-L5GN-Tools, or 'fits the schema on this project' would be mistaken for 'fits the schema'.

conversations.title: COWORK_BRIEF_file_census.md
conversations.why: Second small build-task conversation with a matching committed brief (docs/COWORK_BRIEF_file_census.md) -- another Level 2 ground-truth candidate, and adds a second sample at roughly the same length as #3 so run-to-run spread at one size band can be checked.

conversations.title: Hi Co-work - docs/COWORK_BRIEF_uat_sidebar.md, confirm the task list before proceeding...
conversations.why: Mid-size build-task conversation with a matching committed brief (docs/COWORK_BRIEF_uat_sidebar.md) -- Level 2 candidate; also the first item with a confirm-before-proceeding exchange pattern (plan, confirmation, then work), a shape the smaller items don't have.

conversations.title: CRYSTAL SPIRE -- content thread: ROUTE READ-THROUGH (read-only, analytical)
conversations.why: Second Crystal Spire sample, keeping project breadth present at the medium size band too, not just short.

conversations.title: Create standardized markdown templates
conversations.why: Largest CLI-store session found (16.6K chars in only 6 records -- long individual turns, unlike the cowork items' many-short-turns shape). Keeps the CLI store represented once past the short-tier smoke case.

conversations.title: Task 0 -- Recover the record (do first, blocks nothing else) ...
conversations.why: Build-adjacent conversation (record recovery, not a brief) -- adds a case that is real engineering work but has no docs/COWORK_BRIEF_*.md of its own, so it can't lean on a brief's structure to be well-formed.

conversations.title: build task: docs/cowork_brief_toolkit_self_scan.md
conversations.why: Matches docs/COWORK_BRIEF_toolkit_self_scan.md -- Level 2 candidate. First item to cross ~40K chars; starts the size ramp toward the long tier's largest items.

conversations.title: Scope: Tasks 1 and 2 only. Task 3 (ratification) and Task 4 (stage the archive) ...
conversations.why: A scoped-down build conversation (explicit task subset, deferred work named rather than done) -- tests whether a candidate over-extracts claims for work that was explicitly declared out of scope in the same conversation.

conversations.title: Hi Co-work - UAT walking thread for docs/UAT-toolset-self-scan, whilst A B and C ...
conversations.why: A UAT walk-through rather than a build thread -- different shape again (checklist items being confirmed one at a time, not open design). Closes out the medium tier at just over 70K chars.

conversations.title: task: docs/COWORK_BRIEF_curator_tab.md
conversations.why: Matches docs/COWORK_BRIEF_curator_tab.md -- Level 2 candidate. Also the first item with sidechain (subagent) files present (2 of its 3 source files), a shape none of the smaller items carry.

conversations.title: task: docs/COWORK_BRIEF_unified_app.md ...
conversations.why: Matches docs/COWORK_BRIEF_unified_app.md -- Level 2 candidate. High message count (136) at moderate total size -- many short turns rather than a few long ones, unlike #13 at similar char count.

conversations.title: Task: docs/COWORK_BRIEF_knowledge_curator
conversations.why: Matches docs/COWORK_BRIEF_knowledge_curator.md -- Level 2 candidate. Large (358K chars) -- the K2/K4 stage this whole bench cares about most (the Curator's own build thread), and a real test of context-window headroom for smaller candidates.

conversations.title: task: docs/COWORK_BRIEF_conductor.md
conversations.why: Matches docs/COWORK_BRIEF_conductor.md -- Level 2 candidate. Second-largest item; highest message count among the non-extreme items (237), a stress case for windowing behaviour distinct from raw char count.

conversations.title: # Task list -- close out the golden UAT pass ...
conversations.why: KNOWN-HARD, deliberately included: over 1M characters, by far the largest item in the set. Expected to trigger 'context overflow' (Task 3's taxonomy) on most local candidates -- the point is to see which candidates fail that way versus which fail some other way, not to avoid the failure.

conversations.title: <uploaded_files> MECHANICS_BETA_v1.0.md ...
conversations.why: Third Crystal Spire sample and the highest message-to-char ratio in the set (177 messages, 48K chars -- many very short turns). Keeps project breadth present in the long tier and adds a shape (rapid back-and-forth) none of the L5GN-Tools items have.

conversations.title: hiya co-work! I've given you access to my projects folders that we have been building ...
conversations.why: Foundational, broad-scope conversation spanning multiple projects rather than one brief -- highest message count in the set (319). Closes the long tier with a case that is large in both dimensions (messages and chars) but not the single largest by chars (#17 already covers that extreme).
